title: Saturn Paani Mein Tair Sakta Hai!
idea: Saturn's average density (0.687 g/cm³) is lower than water's, so in theory it would float, even though 764 Earths could fit inside it.

lines.text: Saturn itna halka hai ki paani mein tair sakta hai!
Aur size? Itna bada ki andar 764 Prithvi samaa jaayein!
Par wajan Prithvi se sirf 95 guna, size 764 guna hone par bhi!
Wahan hawa 1800 km/h chalti hai, sabse tez cricket ball se 11 guna!
Aur yeh vishaal gola sirf 10.7 ghante mein ek chakkar ghoom jaata hai!
Bas itna bada bathtub mil jaaye, Saturn tairne lagega! Kisi ko pata tha?

facts.claim: Saturn's mean density is 0.687 g/cm³, lower than water's (about 1 g/cm³), making it the only planet less dense than water
Saturn's volume is about 763.59 times Earth's (about 764 Earths)
Saturn's mass is about 95.16 times Earth's
A day on Saturn lasts 10.656 hours (about 10 h 39 min)
Saturn has winds of about 1,800 km/h
The fastest recorded cricket delivery is 161.3 km/h, bowled by Shoaib Akhtar in 2003; 1800/161 is about 11 times faster
